stem.text: A stationary wave is formed on a stretched string. The diagram illustrates the string at an instant of time when the displacement of the string is at its maximum.

stem.alt: Stationary wave on a string fixed at both ends, drawn at maximum displacement: a trough labelled P on the lower left and a crest in the centre-right, with a dashed equilibrium line between the two fixed points; labels fixed point at each end and string above the crest

stem.text: The frequency of the wave is $250\,\text{Hz}$. Point P on the string has a vertical displacement of $-1.0\,\text{mm}$.
What will be the vertical displacement of the point P after a time of $5\,\text{ms}$?
